Summary: ArchiveIntel evaluates a VPC/private RAG stack for enterprise legal discovery. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking at large scale with strict retention + audit requirements.

Key metrics / requirements:
- Corpus: ~75M documents (mix of scanned PDFs and docx). Estimate 120M passages after chunking.
- Embedding store: target dense vector count ~120M-150M, dimension 1024.
- Traffic: baseline 150k queries/day, peak QPS ~35 (business hours spikes).
- Latency SLO: candidate retrieval <100ms, reranking end-to-end <350-400ms for top-10 re-rank.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query <$0.02 across retrieval+rerank; procurement will push for predictable CPU/GPU committed pricing.
- Security: no source docs may leave customer VPC; embeddings can be stored in managed service in their VPC. Must have SSO (SAML), KMS integration, detailed audit logs (per-request, identity, model version), and 7-year retention mapping for legal hold.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Sofia) — high-level requirements captured (ff_2026-01-22_archivedemo).
- 2026-01-22: Demo of hosted flows; ArchiveIntel pushes back on hosted -> asked for private VPC architecture. (Fireflies: ff_2026-01-22_archivedemo)
- 2026-01-29: Security deep-dive with infra lead + legal. Requested audit log schema and encryption detail. Provided initial SOC2 artifacts.
- 2026-02-10: Technical call with SE Ethan; scope for POC defined: index 5M docs -> validate retrieval latencies and rerank accuracy (ff_2026-02-10_securitycall).
- 2026-02-18: Provided rough cost model and a draft network diagram (drive://ArchiveIntel/network_diagram_vpc.png). Customer requested on-prem variant for air-gapped subset.
- 2026-02-25: Compliance replied with questions on retention controls and export controls. Assigned RI tickets RI-7991 / RI-8122 for audit schema and retention export.

POC scope (agreed):
- Phase 1 (30 days): ingest 5M redacted docs, build embedding index, validate retrieval latencies and top-10 rerank accuracy using customer eval set (500 queries). Measure cost/query and memory footprint.
- Phase 2 (60-90 days): scale validation to 25M docs, test VPC-only deployment, integrate KMS and audit log stream to customer SIEM.

Customer quotes / signals:
- "We cannot send source docs off our VPC — embeddings only if they can be generated inside our environment." — Head of Security
- "If rerank latency exceeds 400ms users will reject this for litigation review workflows." — Product lead
- Procurement threshold: vendor must provide predictable committed pricing for dedicated capacity (monthly).

Technical notes / risk items:
- Mixed content: OCR quality varies; embedding quality may vary across scanned docs -> will require cleanup or OCR pipeline upstream.
- Indexing storage: 120M vectors at 1024 dims will need quantization recommendations (RI Optimize) to hit cost targets. Customer explicitly asked for quantization + rerank hybrid (CPU retrieval + GPU rerank).
- Audit logs: compliance wants per-token costing and per-request model version recorded. Need to confirm retention/export format (RI product input).
